topic: Database warning and data ingestion status
summary_markdown: The conversation focused on a technical issue related to the ClickHouse database, specifically warnings regarding `allunite.raw_devices_seen_buffer`. The warning indicated that not all columns from the data block existed in the destination table (`allunite.raw_devices_seen_2`), causing some columns to be discarded. Someone confirmed this was a persistent warning. A previous issue involving slow data insertion speed was noted, and it was reported that the performance had since improved.
decisions: No concrete decisions were made regarding the database warnings or performance issues.
